links.outcome: Ambient scribe note accuracy compared between Arabic and English encounters
links.effect: Accuracy mean 4.53 (SD 0.46) out of 5 for Arabic vs 4.77 (SD 0.37) for English (P=.06); Arabic slightly lower but not significant.
links.quote: On the Likert scale, for the accuracy domain, the mean score was 4.53 (SD 0.46) out of 5 for Arabic compared with 4.77 (SD 0.37) out of 5 for English (P=.06).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an ambient scribe pipeline on locally collected, manually annotated Arabic consultation audio

screen.reason: Prospective feasibility and real-world deployment evaluation of an Arabic-English ambient AI scribe (Sahl AI) in clinical practice, assessing documentation quality and clinician experience.
